This is a simple tutorial on how to easily make an icon with a long shadow.

You'll be needing:

  • Photoshop
  • A .png icon. Or, you can use This one
  • Long Shadow Generator which you can download here.

The instructions on how to install Long Shadow Generator is available on the website, just scroll down.

Steps:

  • Create a new Photoshop project and set the height to 500px and width to 500px.
  • Drag and drop the icon you downloaded into Photoshop. If it's really small, click the icon where the arrow is pointing at in this image. Click in the width box and set it to 330% or 340%. (The height will automatically be 330%/340% as well.)
  • Create a square or circular shape with any dimensions and fill it with a colour. (Dark colours would be preffered because the icon is white.)
  • Open this before reading the next 2 points.
  • Drag Rectangle 1 under the icon like in point 1.
  • Double click on the white square (where the second arrow begins) and select OK. After that, press delete on your keyboard.
  • Select the icon.
  • Click on the LS icon.
  • Set Long Shadow Length to 320px or 640px. (Shadow Opacity is up to you, but 30% or less looks best for me - Also, make sure that "Flatten" is ticked.)
  • Set the direction you want your shadow here.
  • Click generate.
  • Tap control ctrl+alt+g. (this will cause the shadow to be inside the shape you created.)
  • Save/export

My result.
